extension.description: All the media as fast as possible
extension.news: v5.6.0 - AllDebrid: real cached-torrent detection restored (batch magnet/upload + ready flag, auto-cleans probe magnets so account history stays clean). - AllDebrid: magnet upload now uses the correct magnets[] parameter - link resolves succeed again. - AllDebrid: removed the long playback "countdown" hang on non-cached magnets (wait reduced to 15s and only used when AD reports the magnet as ready/uploading). - AllDebrid: file/link extraction now walks nested folders and uses a stricter video-extension filter so the right episode/movie file is picked. - AllDebrid: matching episode patterns expanded (s01e01, 1x01, ep01, episode 1, etc.). - Cache-check dialog (ResolveURL-side) now performs a real AllDebrid cache check.
